method.same_generation_join: fusion timestamp rounded to microsecond; first complete read and first full output of each fusion
method.time_axis: checked_inputs.checked_at for MPPI, embedded stamp/source for traces; bag receipt only fallback

phase_boundary_basis: safety/finish bag receipts; statuses classified by checked_at, so sub-cycle boundary precision is limited
interpretation_limits: This is evidence from an actual run, not proof that all functions passed vehicle validation.
map_age_ok=false identifies a failed gate, not the exclusive root cause; dynamic/snapshot flags can fail simultaneously.
A fresh field may still age between outputs/checks; current map age is measured from fusion and excludes input-to-fusion age.
54.2185s and 1.9124s map fusion gaps are separate from subsecond ESDF computation; these logs alone do not establish the cause of pauses.
Source-log timing around commit/read includes logging overhead; input residual is arithmetic, not a measured named stage.
Small negative read-log-to-sample or adopt-to-checked values reflect concurrent trace/check timing; these clock markers are not strict serial operation boundaries.
MapTrace and LatencyTrace cannot alone isolate IPC transport, scheduler, and timer latency; callback profiling applies only to sampled status checks.
Map age expiry does not establish a safety violation: the controller rejects delivery when its checks fail.
